title: Fix product upload/edit in admin panel and apply pink button styling site-wide

requirements.text: Fix the 'Add Product' flow in the ProductManagement admin component so that submitting the add-product dialog successfully calls the backend addProduct mutation, persists the new product, and refreshes the product list without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Add Product' and submitting the form with valid data creates a new product in the backend.
The product list refreshes and shows the newly added product after submission.
No console errors or unhandled exceptions occur during the add-product flow.
Validation errors (empty required fields) are shown inline without crashing the form.

requirements.text: Fix the 'Edit Product' flow in the ProductManagement admin component so that opening an existing product in the edit dialog pre-populates all fields correctly, submitting calls the backend updateProduct mutation, and the product list reflects the saved changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Edit' on any product opens the dialog with all existing fields (name, category, price, discount, featured flag, image URL, Amazon link) pre-filled.
Submitting the edit form updates the product in the backend.
The product list refreshes and reflects the updated product data after save.
No console errors or unhandled exceptions occur during the edit-product flow.

requirements.text: Change every button across the entire frontend (public-facing pages including Hero CTAs, ProductGrid, Header, Footer, SocialProof, TrustBadges) and the Admin Panel (AdminLogin, AdminPanel, ProductManagement dialogs, and all tab/action buttons) to use the hot-pink color defined in the Tailwind config (the 'hot-pink' palette token). Remove any remaining non-pink primary button styles and ensure consistency.

quotes: Change all buttons' colors at frontend and Admin Panel backend into pink

acceptanceCriteria: All CTA and action buttons on the public-facing site render with the hot-pink background color.
All buttons inside the Admin Panel (login, register, add product, edit product, delete product, logout, tab navigation) render with the hot-pink background color.
No button retains a non-pink primary color (e.g., blue, gray, or default Tailwind primary).
Hover and focus states are visually consistent with a pink theme (e.g., darker pink on hover).
Destructive/danger buttons (e.g., delete) may use a red variant but all other action buttons must be pink.

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, and the ui components directory.
All backend logic must remain within the single main.mo actor.
Do not alter the existing data schema or break any existing backend query/mutation function signatures.
nonGoals: Adding new product fields or changing the product data model beyond what is needed to fix the upload/edit flows.
Redesigning the admin panel layout or navigation structure.
Changes to blog, newsletter, or site pages management sections.
Any new features beyond fixing product CRUD and button color standardization.
